intent_contract.text: 좀 더 난이도 높은 코스가 보여지게 다시 프롬프트를 작성하고 그려줘.

A lineage-bound revision of the prior candid climbing-gym photograph that preserves the adult subject, outfit, seated shoe-adjusting action, and iPhone snapshot style while making a visibly advanced bouldering problem occupy much more of the frame.

Create a revised natural candid photograph inside a lived-in indoor bouldering gym. An unmistakably adult Korean woman in her early twenties with polished young-pop-star styling wears a gray hoodie loosely layered over a visible white cropped T-shirt with black denim jeans. She sits on a climbing-gym bench, leaning forward to readjust and fasten one climbing shoe, absorbed in the strap. Preserve the imperfect look of a handheld iPhone snapshot and an unposed everyday snapshot with polished young-pop-star styling. Use a vertical lower-third composition: her face, hands, and shoes remain clear while the upper two-thirds reveals one advanced color-matched bouldering problem behind her. The difficult course spans a steep overhanging wall with tiny sloping handholds, sparse footholds, large angled volumes, widely spaced moves, and a high finishing hold, making the challenge readable from the image alone. Mixed practical gym light, muted color, subtle film grain and an off-guard, quietly observed candid mood keep the moment casual and spontaneous.
